A 30s retry doesn't make it "physically can't time out" — it just means it fails after retrying instead of failing on the first attempt. What happens if the retry also times out? Does it retry once, or loop until it succeeds?

Also worth checking: was the original bug a one-off slow request, or does it correlate with export size (e.g. large date ranges)? If it's size-driven, a retry against the same slow endpoint will likely time out again the same way, just later.

Is there a test that reproduces the original timeout and now passes with the retry in place? If the test never actually exercised a slow/timing-out response, a green run doesn't tell us the retry logic actually engages.
